newsitem.title: INDIA: India's CARE rates SPIC CP, debenture.
newsitem.headline: India's CARE rates SPIC CP, debenture.

text.p: India's Credit Analysis & Research Ltd (CARE) on Wednesday said it gave a PR1+ rating for a 1.0 billion rupee commercial paper issue of Southern Petrochemical Industries Corp (SPIC), a leading fertiliser producer.
CARE said it assigned a CARE AA+ rating for SPIC's 1.0 billion rupee non-convertible debenture programme.
CARE said PR1 represented superior investment. The plus or minus sign shown after the rating indicates relative position within the band covered by the rating symbol, CARE said.
SPIC is the flagship of the M.A. Chidambaram group, a leading business house of southern India.
